name: yandex360-mcp
description: Tools for Yandex 360 services (Yandex Wiki) — read and edit wiki pages from your AI assistant.

wiki_token.title: Yandex Wiki OAuth token
wiki_token.description: OAuth token with wiki:read / wiki:write scopes

wiki_org_id.title: Yandex 360 organization ID
wiki_org_id.description: Your Yandex 360 organization ID (sent as the X-Org-Id header)

tools.name: wiki_whoami
tools.description: Current API user — quick access check

tools.name: wiki_get_page
tools.description: Get a wiki page by slug (optional YFM body)

tools.name: wiki_get_page_by_id
tools.description: Get a wiki page by numeric id (optional YFM body)

tools.name: wiki_tree
tools.description: Page tree — descendants of a slug (navigation)

tools.name: wiki_create_page
tools.description: Create a wiki page (title, slug, YFM content)

tools.name: wiki_update_page
tools.description: Update title and/or content of a page by id

tools.name: wiki_append_content
tools.description: Append YFM content to the end of a page

tools.name: wiki_delete_page
tools.description: Delete a wiki page by id (destructive)
